policy: A gate passes only when its evidence record is explicitly marked pass and bound to the exact current runtime and GLB SHA-256 values.

branding_placement_reviewed.method: Exact PVC 2404 parts Figure 8-7 reconciliation, official standard-machine gallery comparison, and four-quadrant Blender render review
branding_placement_reviewed.evidence: The exact 1.0.5 GLB places mirrored ES1930M / MICRO-SIZED badges on both long platform toe boards, outlined JLG wordmarks directly on both platform end boards, and black/teal JLG installations on both chassis access-door faces. All four stowed quadrants were visually reviewed on 2026-08-26. Marks are independently typeset nominative geometry rather than copied decal artwork; typography and sticker-cut contours remain an explicit visual approximation.

stowed_silhouette_reviewed.method: Four-quadrant Blender render review against both official standard-machine gallery views
stowed_silhouette_reviewed.evidence: Exact 1.0.5 source and GLB were reviewed from front-right, front-left, rear-right and rear-left on 2026-08-26. The stowed five-level stack, platform guard silhouette, console carrier, end boards, mirrored model badges and both chassis-door marking treatments remain coherent. This is an offline source/asset review, not a current browser or deployed-pages claim.

platform_controls_visual_reviewed.method: Official PVC 2404 figure comparison plus local desktop and mobile browser close review
platform_controls_visual_reviewed.evidence: The inward-facing removable station visibly includes the molded carrier, operator-facing phone cradle, integrated symbol-and-status legend with battery bars, joystick boot, grip, rocker and trigger, mushroom E-stop, selectors, alarm, USB, warning and capacity lenses, hardware and standard relaxed harness. Its exported control-board hierarchy now uses the 600S PlatformConsole, PlatformConsoleFace and PlatformConsoleDisplay naming convention; validation prohibits legacy PlatformControls naming and the optional coiled cable.

raised_pose_browser_reviewed.method: Local in-app browser full-lift and full-extension visual review
raised_pose_browser_reviewed.evidence: Full lift plus 0.55 m extension rendered continuously with dynamic bounds framing, selection self-test pass, zero runtime errors, 60 fps and 17.7 ms p95 on 2026-08-25.

extension_browser_reviewed.method: Local browser full-extension review plus exported six-pair mesh-bound gates
extension_browser_reviewed.evidence: Fixed outer and moving inner rails and toe boards retain 0.568 m, 0.293 m and 0.018 m overlap at 0, 50 and 100 percent travel with 3-4 mm lateral clearance and no guard opening.

steering_boundary_reviewed.method: Static manual contract, numerical presentation-route validator and local browser review
steering_boundary_reviewed.evidence: Manual steering remains bounded to the verified 80 mm cylinder presentation with unsupported spindle response neutral. The reconstructed route uses 1.07 m wheelbase and 0.67 m track Ackermann geometry. Six directional probes and 2400 continuous samples prove both front wheels steer with machine yaw after reconciling Three.js X/Z handedness to the 600S negative-determinant convention; maximum visual steer remains 0.570 rad below its 0.58 rad cap.

figure_eight_presentation_reviewed.method: 2400-sample numerical route validator plus desktop and 390x844 browser exercise
figure_eight_presentation_reviewed.evidence: The Gerono path closes, crosses center with finite tangent, holds approximately 0.72 m/s, steers both front wheels into each lobe, remains inside the reconstructed steering envelope without clamp scrub, integrates four path-radius wheel speeds against the authored 0.13 m radius, remains within its presentation floor, stays stowed, follows with the camera, and supports pause, resume and manual takeover. The control board now uses the same Drive mode, Auto loop and Start/Pause/Resume auto terminology as the 600S while retaining the explicit reconstruction boundary.

mobile_drag_direction_reviewed.method: Deterministic pointer-type direction validator, exact 600S camera-basis equivalence and 390x844 layout review
mobile_drag_direction_reviewed.evidence: Touch right and down deltas now match the 600S flagship orbit despite the ES camera's different spherical basis; mouse behavior remains unchanged. This is synthetic projected-camera proof, not a physical-device claim.

accessibility_reviewed.method: Keyboard dialog review plus native route-control semantics inspection
accessibility_reviewed.evidence: About focused the close button, Escape closed the modal and restored the About opener. The aria-live Drive mode changes only on state transitions, the toggle exposes pressed state, Pause auto becomes Resume auto with Paused status, reduced motion locks travel, and native slider input cancels the route.

desktop_browser_zero_errors.method: Local in-app browser diagnostics and console inspection
desktop_browser_zero_errors.evidence: Exact 1.0.4 GLB loaded with runtime error count zero, no console warnings or errors and stable 60 fps sampling.

mobile_and_pinch_reviewed.method: 390x844 collapsed and expanded browser review plus deterministic gesture validator
mobile_and_pinch_reviewed.evidence: The control panel and route card fit both mobile states. Five pinch cases prove monotonic zoom and clamps; touch direction matches the flagship camera basis while mouse direction remains preserved. No physical touchscreen claim is made.

selection_and_focus_reviewed.method: Three-state rig self-test plus local platform focus
selection_and_focus_reviewed.evidence: Dynamic interaction volumes passed self-test; Platform focus framed the upgraded controller and safely canceled and reset the presentation route.

performance_reviewed.method: Local in-app browser rolling frame sample
performance_reviewed.evidence: The 407-node, 282-mesh, 35,344-triangle exact GLB held 60 fps with observed p95 17.7-18.4 ms while stowed, raised and following the route.

deployed_pages_reviewed.method: Exact GitHub Pages byte comparison and deployed in-app browser exercise
deployed_pages_reviewed.evidence: Pages run 32921620302 deployed commit f0166f8a73659d10871026a91421589796b3c6f3 successfully. Public ES1930M HTML, runtime.js, presentation-route.mjs and 1.0.4 GLB matched the reviewed local SHA-256 values byte-for-byte. The live GLB passed selection self-test, displayed the 600S-aligned Drive mode and Auto loop terms, ran the corrected figure-eight at 60 fps, and reported zero runtime, console, or warning errors on 2026-08-25.

600s_regression_suite_pass.evidence: The 600S viewer, evidence, configuration and exact accepted GLB validators passed against the same 1.0.5 ES1930M branding checkout on 2026-08-26; no 742 files or contracts were part of this change.
